# GitHub Configuration

This directory contains GitHub-specific repository support files.

## Purpose

These files help standardize contribution, review, and automation workflows for the Detection Engineering repository.

## What May Be Stored Here

Examples include:

- pull request templates
- issue templates
- GitHub Actions workflows
- repository governance helpers
- validation or deployment workflow definitions

## Goal

The goal of this directory is to support a clean, reviewable, and scalable engineering workflow for repository changes.
